title: Tiger cub wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points="50,8 38,30 62,30" fill="#ff4fa3"/>
  <polygon points="50,8 44,20 56,20" fill="#ffd93d"/>
  <polygon points="50,8 47,15 53,15" fill="#4fd1ff"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="7" r="3" fill="#ffd93d"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="36" r="9" fill="#ff9a3d"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="36" r="5" fill="#ffd0a0"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="36" r="9" fill="#ff9a3d"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="36" r="5" fill="#ffd0a0"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="28" ry="25" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <!-- Cheek fur tufts -->
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="58" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#ffd0a0"/>
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="58" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#ffd0a0"/>
  <!-- Stripes on head -->
  <rect x="46" y="30" width="8" height="6" rx="2" fill="#8a4a1a"/>
  <rect x="34" y="36" width="4" height="9" rx="2" fill="#8a4a1a" transform="rotate(-15 36 40)"/>
  <rect x="62" y="36" width="4" height="9" rx="2" fill="#8a4a1a" transform="rotate(15 64 40)"/>
  <rect x="22" y="45" width="4" height="8" rx="2" fill="#8a4a1a" transform="rotate(-25 24 49)"/>
  <rect x="74" y="45" width="4" height="8" rx="2" fill="#8a4a1a" transform="rotate(25 76 49)"/>
  <!-- Face muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="63" rx="15" ry="11" fill="#fff0d0"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="50" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2a5a4a"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="50" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2a5a4a"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <path d="M46 60 L54 60 L50 65 Z" fill="#ff5a7a"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M50 65 L50 68 M50 68 Q46 72 43 68 M50 68 Q54 72 57 68" stroke="#c04060" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1="26" y1="62" x2="36" y2="63" stroke="#ffd0a0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="26" y1="67" x2="36" y2="66" stroke="#ffd0a0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="74" y1="62" x2="64" y2="63" stroke="#ffd0a0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="74" y1="67" x2="64" y2="66" stroke="#ffd0a0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="86" rx="20" ry="14" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <!-- Paws -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="95" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#ffd0a0"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="95" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#ffd0a0"/>
  <!-- Chest stripes -->
  <rect x="44" y="78" width="12" height="4" rx="2" fill="#8a4a1a"/>
</svg>
